en: The postcard features a sepia-toned historical photograph of a bustling fish dock or harbor area. Numerous people are gathered along the waterfront, some appearing to be workers or possibly fishermen and others in period dress. Sailing ships and small boats are moored or floating in the water. The background shows old buildings typical of a European coastal town. At the top is printed 'No. 24. LA CORUÑA — Muelle del Pescado.' and there is a visible postage stamp in the upper right bearing the word 'ESPAÑA'.
